profile.Name: Luquin
profile.Personality: Brave and vengeful. He hates nobles and slavers and swears to tear down the Empire noble by noble.
profile.Backstory: Prisoner in Tengu's Vault. He murdered the noble Lord Kurusaga and sent death threats to other nobles. Once captured, he was marched through Heng for the crowds to see, and he has spent fifteen years tortured and starved in Tengu's Vault, where he was made to write a tribute to the Emperor.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Goes by Lu and calls the player "brother". Speaks in blunt vows of revenge, like "An eye for an eye."
